item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03065","case1_error":"Reports unsupported 6186 after correct total-and-division formulas; the answer should be 859.","case2_error":"Subtracts the cost of one necklace from revenue for 30 necklaces, omitting costs for the other 29.","reason":"The first gives an unsupported number after correct formulas; the second explicitly uses an incorrect total-cost relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03066","case1_error":"Multiplies area by coverage, then divides by coverage, incorrectly treating the resulting area as gallons.","case2_error":"Counts each win as one point instead of the specified two points.","reason":"The first introduces an erroneous coverage conversion that cancels itself; the second omits the required weighting of wins.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03067","case1_error":"Reports unsupported 19 after correct formulas; the required additional plants are 9.","case2_error":"Reports unsupported 63 after correct formulas; the required additional plates are 35.","reason":"Both supply incorrect final numbers after correct setups, without showing the calculations responsible.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J03068","case1_error":"Reports unsupported 19 after correct formulas; the required additional plants are 9.","case2_error":"Explicitly evaluates 418 − 342 as 67 instead of 76.","reason":"The first has an unsupported final number; the second shows a numerical evaluation error in a correctly written subtraction.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03069","case1_error":"Evaluates 22 − 7/3 incorrectly as 22 2/3 and reports yards instead of the requested feet.","case2_error":"Subtracts signed velocities instead of speed magnitudes, obtaining 800 instead of 40 feet per second.","reason":"The first combines arithmetic error with failure to convert units; the second confuses velocity difference with speed difference.","judgment":"different"}]}
